en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone was in the dining hall...
besides Kokichi and Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>But mentally, they weren't really there.
The life had gone out of their eyes.
...Everyone here looks terrible.
Really? Even I look terrible?
Well...your face always looks like that.
What are we talking about...?
We're discussing how we wanna die, right?
...What?

I wanna go without suffering...
Maki...can you do something about that?
Sure...but before that, take a look at this.
Is that...a Flashback Light?

Even in such a dire situation, robophobia
still persists...

I will not let Kokichi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltNORMAL> win in the
end...

As students of Hope's Peak Academy, we
must unite and fight back against despair!
Don't stop me...I just wanna die.

Tenko...probably wouldn't be mad
if I chose to die in this situation...

If we don't stop Kokichi—a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant of Despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>—
then this despair will never end...

But something like that would be a cinch 
for my magic! It's overflowing with <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

After you've undone the alarm system 
and electric barrier, then leave it to me!

The Flashback Light... But now that 
we've learned everything...
There's...no point to it...

How did I forget I was a student 
of Hope's Peak Academy...?

I suspect that Kokichi was very deliberate
about erasing our memories...

Because we've gained newfound power now
that we remember Hope's Peak Academy.

Hm, Kokichi was afraid of us awakening 
the power of <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Yeah!

Let's do it, Shuichi! Let's rescue Kaito
and stop Kokichi!

Let's do it, Shuichi! Let's rescue Kaito
and stop Kokichi!

<CLT=cltMIND>Is that...a Flashback Light?
Why does Maki have it?
<CLT=cltMIND>I should ask Maki about this.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>Is that...a Flashback Light?
Why does Maki have it?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Dining Hall Rules"

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"You may eat any food you
find in the dining hall."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"Please take responsibility for all utensils and
dishes used and clean up after yourself."

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"The dining hall will be locked
during nighttime."

<CLT=cltMIND>Is that...a Flashback Light?
Why does Maki have it?
<CLT=cltMIND>I should ask Maki about this.
Maki...why do you have that?

It was on top of the table when I went to
the dining hall this morning.
It was just...sitting there?
Kokichi probably just put it there...
To...confirm the truth, perhaps?

If we use that Flashback Light, we may recover
memories that corroborate his story...

So we're supposed to use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=typeNORMAL>
to confirm the <CLT=cltSTRONG>truth<CLT=typeNORMAL> Kokichi told us...

We don't need to confirm anything...
We saw...the outside world for ourselves..

Do you want to die...comfortably?
I can help you, but...
We should check this Flashback Light first.
...What?
Why do we have to do that?
It's the only thing we can do right now.

If we're going to die, then we might as well do
anything we can. We'll have no regrets that way.

And...even if it is dangerous, it wouldn't
matter anymore, right?

Either way, there's nothing for us to lose...
We don't have any hope left.
So, let's do what we can.

Well, okay... Things won't end up any worse
than they already are.

So when you kill me...will it be like 
I'm falling asleep?

...Then it's decided. Keebo, Shuichi...are you
fine with that?
Yes... Very well, then.
Y-Yeah...

<CLT=cltMIND>And thus it was decided,
fairly painlessly.

<CLT=cltMIND>A Flashback Light suddenly appeared.
Nothing could be more obvious and suspicious.

<CLT=cltMIND>But because our spirits were already
broken, we had nothing to lose anyway...
Okay...I'm going to turn it on.
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki switched on the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND>.
<CLT=cltMIND>And at that moment...
<CLT=cltMIND>The world—
<CLT=cltMIND>Flipped upside-down—
<CLT=cltMIND>Turned inside-out—
<CLT=cltMIND>That's... That's it!
<CLT=cltMIND>I remember!
<CLT=cltMIND>Everything...is...connected...
<CLT=cltMIND>And we...had forgotten...

<CLT=cltMIND>We had forgotten that
<CLT=cltSTRONG>everything is connected<CLT=cltMIND>!
<CLT=cltMIND>It all started at <CLT=cltSTRONG>that academy<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>A government-backed school that nurtured
the most talented students in various subjects...
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Hope's Peak Academy<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>And the event that tore that school
apart...changed the world.

<CLT=cltMIND>The biggest, most awful, most tragic
event in human history.

<CLT=cltMIND>It triggered a wave of terrorism and war across
the world. Humanity's true <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Half the world was destroyed as a
result of the terrible violence.

<CLT=cltMIND>And that tragedy was caused by
a single high school girl.
<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Despair<CLT=cltMIND>, Junko Enoshima.

<CLT=cltMIND>She used whatever means necessary
to paint the world in despair.

<CLT=cltMIND>The killing game of the 78th class of
Hope's Peak Academy was the same way.

<CLT=cltMIND>Trapped by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Despair<CLT=cltMIND>,
forced into a killing game...
<CLT=cltMIND>But after <CLT=cltSTRONG>Junko Enoshima<CLT=cltMIND> died...

<CLT=cltMIND>the case was closed, and the world
began to slowly recover.

<CLT=cltMIND>But Junko's disciples, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=cltMIND>,
weren't done sowing chaos.

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Future Foundation<CLT=cltMIND> fought against them,
trying to restore order.

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>war between hope and despair<CLT=cltMIND>
grew more and more extreme...

<CLT=cltMIND>The fight raged on, but came
to a sudden end.

<CLT=cltMIND>And...right then...
It was from then on that we remembered...
<CLT=cltMIND>It was the beginning of <CLT=cltSTRONG>our truth<CLT=cltMIND>!

<CLT=cltMIND>One day, terrible despair suddenly
rained from the sky...

<CLT=cltMIND>A countless number of meteorites fell upon
the world, carrying an unknown virus.

<CLT=cltMIND>Emboldened by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>overwhelming despair<CLT=cltMIND>, the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants<CLT=cltMIND> cried, "Humanity deserves damnation!"

<CLT=cltMIND>The Future Foundation was overwhelmed by the
renewed despair and quickly lost influence.
<CLT=cltMIND>But then...

<CLT=cltMIND>Makoto Naegi, together with the former
members of the Future Foundation...

<CLT=cltMIND>started the <CLT=cltSTRONG>"Gofer Project"<CLT=cltMIND>
at Hope's Peak Academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>"Only genius can overcome nature.
And only hope can overcome despair..."

<CLT=cltMIND>"Our young geniuses must escape this Earth,
to become the seeds of the future..."
<CLT=cltMIND>"That is the only hope for humanity."

<CLT=cltMIND>With those principles, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=cltMIND> began,
and 16 Hope's Peak students were selected.
<CLT=cltMIND>We...were those 16 students.

<CLT=cltMIND>That's it! We weren't all attending
different high schools...

<CLT=cltMIND>We were all attending the rebuilt
Hope's Peak Academy!

<CLT=cltMIND>We were the students that applied after
learning Hope's Peak was rebuilt.

<CLT=cltMIND>And the new Hope's Peak was
like the last, in that...

<CLT=cltMIND>it accepted applications for talented students,
and cultivated <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltMIND> talents...

<CLT=cltMIND>Hope's Peak Academy was a large school,
so we were all in separate classes...

<CLT=cltMIND>But we were all students of 
Hope's Peak Academy.

<CLT=cltMIND>From the candidates, the 16 of us were
selected for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=cltMIND> because..
<CLT=cltMIND>...No, we weren't "selected."
<CLT=cltMIND>We were the only ones left.

<CLT=cltMIND>The mysterious virus from the meteorites
had spread rapidly around the world...

<CLT=cltMIND>The entire world was on the brink
of extinction.

<CLT=cltMIND>Hope had almost triumphed...but cruel despair
came roaring back to overtake the world.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...we just happened to be immune to the virus...

<CLT=cltMIND>That was the reason why we were chosen
for the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=cltMIND>.
<CLT=cltMIND>I finally...remembered.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>That world<CLT=cltMIND>...<CLT=cltSTRONG>this world<CLT=cltMIND>...
It's all connected!
Everyone! Did you all remember!?
Yes! I can vividly recall <CLT=cltSTRONG>everything<CLT=typeNORMAL> now!

Y-Yeah... Why... How...could we forget 
something so important.
We were students of Hope's Peak Academy!

We were the <CLT=cltSTRONG>symbols of hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> entrusted
with the survival of humanity!
Except for...one person.

Kokichi Oma...the mastermind behind this killing
game...his organization's real identity...
They were the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

That's right. The cult organization out to
destroy the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

If Kokichi is the leader, that means he
controls the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Out of all of us...he is the closest to the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

It's so obvious... A killing game like this 
could only be done by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

Class trials... Monokuma... The students 
of Hope's Peak Academy...

It's all just like Junko Enoshima's 
killing game.

Only someone who worships the Ultimate 
Despair would replicate that killing game.

Which means that this killing game is just
like the one that came before...
It's a battle between hope and despair.

<CLT=cltMIND>A killing game that mires hope
in dark despair.
Wait...hold on.

If this was such an important killing game,
then why did Kokichi abandon it?

That's also something the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>
would do. They admire Junko Enoshima, right?

He made an elaborate plan to cause us to 
despair, but he got <CLT=cltSTRONG>bored<CLT=typeNORMAL> of that plan...

Wanting to feel the despair of your plan being 
ruined... That's the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> for you.
...What's wrong, Maki?
Nothing... I'm just not convinced...

It's probably...fine, though.
It's not a big deal.
...Are you sure?

We finally learned the truth, but we 
still can't do anything...

Even if we get out of this academy, the outside
world is still destroyed.
There's...no hope left for us.
No! We just need to become that hope!
Huh? What's with you all of a sudden?

If all hope is lost, then it's up to us to become
that hope!

After all, we're students of Hope's Peak
Academy, aren't we!?

We're all that's left of the 16 who survived the
battle between hope and despair!

If we give up now, everyone who fought on the
side of <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> will have fought for nothing!
Fought for...nothing...
That's...what my inner voice is telling me.

That no matter what, I cannot abandon <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
I cannot give up...
Yes, that's what it's urging me to do.

So I will not despair! Even if it's only a little,
I will move forward with <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL>!
Keebo...

Right now, there is no use in thinking about
whether our lives have meaning or not...

Because as long as we're alive, we still have the
power to decide that meaning for ourselves...
That's what I believe <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> is!

That's what <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> is...
I see... Yeah, you're right...

We're the students of the new <CLT=cltSTRONG>Hope's Peak
Academy<CLT=cltNORMAL>, rebuilt as the symbol of hope...

If we—the students of Hope's Peak—give up, 
the world really will be plunged into despair!

I got it! In the end, it's all about willpower!
I'm gonna live till the end and never give up!

We won't be able to do anything 
in that destroyed world...

But making the impossible possible 
is what magic is all about!

It's a pain, but it'll be worth it! I'll live!
I'll live for a hundred million more years!
<CLT=cltMIND>You guys...
...You're right. Let's do it.

Let's fight, together!
Against despair!

Yes! As long as we stand together, without
giving in to despair, we will find a new hope!
<CLT=cltMIND>We all stood in unison.

<CLT=cltMIND>We each felt the power of <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltMIND> coursing
through us, driving our bodies.

<CLT=cltMIND>The hope born in this academy,
a tree of life with roots down deep...

<CLT=cltMIND>It was supporting each and every
one of us.

Nyeeeh... Motivation is rushing through 
my entire body.

Hiii hee hee hee! 
This is the power of <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL>!

With a laugh like that, you sound less like 
a mage and more like a wicked witch.

Kokichi may have left that <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=typeNORMAL>
to make us give up...
But if that was his plan, it failed.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's true...it does seem as though
Kokichi's plan went wrong somewhere.

<CLT=cltMIND>The only person who can give us
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Lights<CLT=cltMIND>...is Kokichi.

Ah, so...what's our plan now?
What are we going to do about Kokichi?

We've gotta stop You-Know-Who, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant
of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>, or this despair will never end.
We have to...save Kaito, too.
Yeah, of course!

He's so stupidly positive. He's just the kind
of guy we need at a time like this.

With Kaito by our side encouraging us, then
even if we are the only people left...
...I think we can still find a new hope.
<CLT=cltMIND>Yeah...that's exactly right.

<CLT=cltMIND>I knew that...even in a situation like this,
he'd think of something!
The problem is...where *are* Kokichi and Kaito?
They're in the Exisal hangar.
Both of them?

Kokichi did say that Kaito would be
trapped in there, but...

By chance... I happened to see Kokichi leaving
the hangar during nighttime yesterday.
By chance? Really?

I bet the truth is you were worried about 
Kaito and were watching the hangar all day.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Looks like that was the case.

It's not like I was worried about Kaito or
anything. I just...had nothing else to do.

Also...I'm used to watching others, so it
wasn't any trouble.

It's important for assassins to watch their
targets, and think of ways to kill them—

Stop, stop. We were just getting mushy,
but you had to make it all bloody instead.

We know they're in the Exisal hangar, but how
do we get them out?

The hangar has an alarm system that will go
off if anyone approaches the shutter.

On top of that, Kokichi has the alarm remote
key to shut off that alarm system.

And there's also an electric barrier, right?
You'd need to do something about that, too.

Yes, but...even approaching the control panel
will set off the alarm, too...

Nyeeeh... So many problems right from the start.
What should we do?

It'll be fine. I think I know how to stop the
alarm system and the electric barrier.
<CLT=cltMIND>Does she...have an idea?

How do you plan to get past the
alarm system and barrier?
With the Electrohammer.

If you hit the control panel with it, it should
disable the electric barrier.

We did the same thing to the electronic lock 
on the exit to the outside world.

But...it won't work the same way on the
alarm system, will it?

The alarm will go off before we can even get
close enough to use the Electrohammer...
Then, we'll use this.
Ah, is that...?

Nee-heehee... It's not *exactly* a bomb, though.
Even if it is called an <CLT=cltSTRONG>Electrobomb<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

It jams electronic signals by scattering particles
that interfere with electromagnetic waves.

For two hours, any and all electronic devices
within 50 yards will be completely disabled.

It's perfect for any secret activities, too,
since it doesn't leave any debris behind.

This invention is extraordinary! But I only
have three of them...

So I need to use them carefully. You guys will
have to settle for the Electrohammers.

Wh-Why do you have that, Maki? There were
only three and I thought Kokichi had them—
I stole it from his pocket.
...During that time.

Nyeh, as expected! Your kleptomania
and terrifying glare are both first-class!

Th-The terrifying glare part was a joke...
So...can you stop glaring at me so terrifyingly...?

Nice work, Maki! We can use that Electrobomb
to get inside the hangar!
Not only that, it will disable all communication.

That *should* include the remote control
Kokichi uses for the Exisals.

If we use the Electrobomb in front of the
shutter, it should affect the entire hangar.

Then Kokichi'll be as good as butt naked! All
he'll be able to do is hold his crotch and run!

But he might still be able to control an
Exisal from inside...
Butt naked!?
No, I'm pretty sure he'll be clothed.

Then we should bring the Electrohammers
as a precaution against the Exisals.

Nyeeeh, dang... I just left mine sitting 
around without charging it.
Ah...sorry, but I did too...

It takes 24 hours to charge an Electrohammer,
so we'll have to wait until tomorrow morning.

...We're going to wait until tomorrow
morning? What about the hangar?

Umm...we don't really have a choice, do we?
Without the Electrohammers, it's impossible.

Maki...I know that you don't want to wait
a single minute more than necessary...

but we shouldn't try this until tomorrow.
When everyone is ready.

Fine, that's what we'll do then... This time,
we'll definitely kill him.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kill...?

No, Maki, you can't! Even if he's a
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant of Despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>, that doesn't—

But if we kill him, then everything will end.
We have no other choice.
For that reason...I will kill him.
But you can't...

I understand how you feel, Maki...
But we'd feel bad after we killed him.

It would be no different than the killing game
that has caused us so much suffering.

Yeah. That's the sort of thing the 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> or Kira would do.
But...Kaito said that killing is wrong...remember?
So...we can't...

...Fine. If everyone thinks that way, then
I'll listen to you guys.

But if it seems like anything dangerous is
going to happen, then I'll definitely kill him.
W-Wow, Maki's actually reliable...?

No, she's dangerous. There's nothing more
dangerous than a heated Maki Roll.

If a Maki Roll gets too heated, you could
burn your tongue!

D-Did you...see those eyes? They were like
a predator looking at its prey.
Ah, you may have deserved that, Himiko...

<CLT=cltMIND>But...it's true that this is
quite...unexpected.

<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't think we'd be able to stand
together as one again.
<CLT=cltMIND>And it's...thanks to Maki.

<CLT=cltMIND>While we were sedentary, feeling sorry
for ourselves, she was planning...

<CLT=cltMIND>I suppose it might also
be thanks to Kaito...

<CLT=cltMIND>Because Kaito was worried about her,
she promised to work hard to do her best...

<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, of course, if I pointed that out,
she'd ask me if I wanted to die again.
...What are *you* looking at?
Ah! S-Sorry...

...Let's do our best. Then the three of us...
can train together again.
Y-Yeah...right.

<CLT=cltMIND>We finalized our plan to get into
the Exisal hangar tomorrow morning.

<CLT=cltMIND>Until then, we would wait for the Electrohammers
to recharge and finish preparations.
<CLT=cltMIND>We split up, focused and determined.
